image_description: A vertical shot of a steep, sandy-colored cliff face on the left. A young boy in green shorts is captured mid-air, jumping off the cliff towards the right. Below him, two other boys stand on the rocky ground looking up. The background shows a clear blue sky and a distant horizon line with water/beach. The rock face has visible texture and some vegetation.

The red object (possibly a frisbee or toy) lacks defined edges and seems to fuse with the boy's distorted hand/arm. It does not have a clear physical form.

The two boys standing below have slightly warped proportions. The boy in the white shirt has legs that seem disproportionately long or angled oddly relative to the ground plane.
